sections.content: Puesto que and ya que both introduce a reason (a more formal register than porque); en cuanto a shifts the topic to something specific; por consiguiente draws a conclusion. Together they're the connective tissue of an argumentative historical paragraph. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Puesto que técnicamente se le había 'ofrecido' la oportunidad de someterse, cualquier resistencia posterior se consideraba una rebelión.
items.english: Since they had technically been 'offered' the chance to submit, any later resistance was considered a rebellion.

items.spanish: En cuanto a la superioridad militar española, suele exagerarse.
items.english: As for Spanish military superiority, it tends to be exaggerated.

items.spanish: Ya que los ejércitos indígenas aprendían rápido, en cuestión de pocas batallas desarrollaron tácticas específicas.
items.english: Since indigenous armies learned quickly, within just a few battles they developed specific tactics.

items.spanish: Por consiguiente, entender la conquista únicamente como tecnología superior es una simplificación.
items.english: Consequently, understanding the conquest solely as superior technology is an oversimplification.

sections.content: En cuanto a is a topic-shifter, not a cause or consequence — use it to say "turning now to X" inside a paragraph that covers several related points. Por consiguiente is the most formal of the app's consequence connectors so far; it fits an argument's final step, right before a conclusion.
